journeyHub.metaDescription: A short assessment, instant insights, and a personal roadmap of practices and conversations - delivered to you over time. Together, at your own pace.
journeyHub.h1: A journey built for your relationship
journeyHub.lede: Generic relationship advice never quite fits your relationship. Answer a 5-minute assessment and get a personal roadmap - short practices, real conversations and weekly challenges that move you from "we should work on us" to actually doing it, 5 minutes a day.
journeyHub.resumeHint: You've got a relationship assessment in progress - pick up where you left off.

why.title: Not generic advice. A path built around you.

0.p: A short assessment maps your relationship across 7 dimensions. Your roadmap starts exactly where you need it - not where a generic course says to start.

1.p: No content dumps. Each week a new chapter opens - a practice, a challenge, or a shared conversation. Enough time to feel it, try it, come back.

2.p: Every piece is co-authored with couples therapists. Practical, research-based, actually doable - not Instagram quotes.

3.p: Both partners see the same journey. Mark conversations, write reflections, and watch how you progress - together, for real.

0.title: Map your relationship in 5 minutes
0.body: 15 short questions on communication, conflict, intimacy, and routine. By the end you'll see exactly where you stand - no jargon, no filler.

1.title: Get a diagnostic you can actually use
1.body: Instant results: your 3 strongest areas, your 2 biggest friction points, and the one thing most worth working on first.

2.title: Small practices, at your own pace
2.body: Short practices that add up to about an hour a week - depending on your time and availability. Try them, check in together, and feel the shift at a pace that fits your life.

inside.title: Small practices that change a lot

0.p: Little connection moments - 5 minutes a day that build the couple muscle.

1.p: Guided prompts that open places you don't always reach on your own.

2.p: One thing per week - an outing, a gesture, an experiment - that breaks the routine.

3.p: Short clips from couples therapists, then space for you to write what came up.

ctaBlock.title: The assessment is free. The journey begins when you're in.
ctaBlock.sub: Take 5 minutes, answer the questionnaire, and get your diagnostic. No commitment - just direction.

0.a: Less than 5 minutes. You can pause mid-way and come back - we save your place.

1.q: Can we do this as a couple?
1.a: Yes - that's the point. You each answer separately, then see the joint diagnostic and start the journey together.

2.q: What if we start and don't keep going?
2.a: Totally fine. Every chapter that has opened stays open - you can come back any time. No pressure, no countdown.

3.a: Yes. Your answers aren't shared - only the two of you and the system see them. We never use them for marketing.

4.a: The assessment and diagnostic are free. If you want to continue to the full journey, you'll get the option at the end of the diagnostic.
